scope: Known target counts, eleven candidates, disjoint target memberships, binary high/low queries, exact unrounded rare-TPR mean; four adaptive individual-identification queries after counts are known
decoder: Recover seven h counts from each exact mean. Restore complemented old-query h to n-h, follow the transported historical response path, and return its unique projected membership. Decode the fourth singleton from its four unique code bits. All four complete observations identify one full assignment; full initial response branches are disjoint
generation: Independently generate every state in each historical representative initial-response fiber, validate its certificate state hash, move it through each incidence-preserving candidate/team permutation, verify all 209 historical independently regenerated branch hashes, and append each of the exactly two unused candidates as the fourth singleton. The other candidate remains unassigned
padding_construction: Complement every old question selecting more than five candidates. In each of the seven targets choose the first M-k known nonmembers in addition to its k selected candidates. All concrete 24-row high-side masks have total M, and known-negative padding contributes no positives. Extra singleton queries always select five candidates
